title: Hom cohomology classes are homotopy classes with the boundary criterion
statement: Let C be a preadditive category, K,L integer cochain complexes and n an integer [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. CohomologyClass K L n is Cocycle K L n modulo coboundaries. Its projection mk is surjective, additive, and mk(c)=0 if and only if c is a coboundary. The map toHom sends mk(c) to the homotopy class of Cocycle.equivHomShift.symm c and is bijective. Equivalently toHom(mk(c))=0 if and only if c is a coboundary. Thus equality of the homotopy classes of two such maps is equivalent to their cocycle difference being a coboundary.
